compose:
services:

  vllm_0:
    image: cloudriftai/1cat-vllm-sm70:1.2.2-cloudrift
    container_name: vllm_0
    deploy:
      resources:
        reservations:
          devices:
            - driver: nvidia
              device_ids: ['0', '1', '2', '3', '4', '5', '6', '7']
              capabilities: [gpu]
    volumes:
      - /hf_models:/hf_models
    environment:
      - HUGGING_FACE_HUB_TOKEN=
      - HF_HOME=/hf_models
      - VLLM_SM70_FLASH_ATTN_V100=1
      - VLLM_SM70_FP8_TURBOMIND=0
      - VLLM_SM70_FP8_MOE_DEQUANT_FALLBACK=1
      - VLLM_SM70_FP8_MOE_BATCHED_GEMM=0
    ports:
      - "8000:8000"
    shm_size: '16gb'
    ipc: host
    restart: unless-stopped
    command: >
      --trust-remote-code
      --gpu-memory-utilization=0.9
      --host 0.0.0.0
      --port 8000
      --tensor-parallel-size 8
      --pipeline-parallel-size 1
      --data-parallel-size 1
      --model poolside/Laguna-S-2.1-FP8
      --served-model-name poolside/Laguna-S-2.1-FP8
      --max-model-len 4096
      --max-num-seqs 1
      --revision 9e0b8ba630080b0e6f20a7b43294a9f2232fd247
      --dtype half --attention-backend FLASH_ATTN_V100 --max-num-batched-tokens 1024 --enforce-eager --disable-custom-all-reduce --enable-auto-tool-choice --tool-call-parser poolside_v1 --reasoning-parser poolside_v1 --default-chat-template-kwargs '{"enable_thinking": true}'
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "bash", "-c", "curl -f http://localhost:8000/health"]
      interval: 10s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 180
      start_period: 1200s
